interpretation.primary_result: Cyber-only produced the highest Y6 PR-AUC in this controlled GRU experiment.
interpretation.physical_only: Physical-only performance was substantially lower than cyber-only.
interpretation.joint_result: Adding physical features reduced Y6 PR-AUC by approximately 0.02634 relative to cyber-only.
interpretation.temporal_result: Adding the non-composite temporal-derived features recovered approximately 0.02035 PR-AUC relative to the joint model, but remained below cyber-only.
interpretation.scientific_caution: This experiment does not establish that physical information is intrinsically harmful or useless. The result is specific to this controlled GRU configuration and synthetic cyber-label setting.
